title: Jude and the Crown
author: Wren Sandoval
blurb: Ivo Blackwood, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
